body:
Seen in run 0442c97d6b8bf128 on task:be36c1d67353660d. At step 76, `submit --project solace-cli` failed and said `Draft 73c7f0acd69c0d39 retained`. At step 78, `drafts drop 73c7f0acd69c0d39` came back with `E0106 draft not found in this task/session`.

A likely cause, not confirmed: the `drafts drop` was sent **without** `--project solace-cli`, so it probably looked in the root project's store, while the draft lives in `solace-cli`'s store. `drafts.drop_owned` deletes by id and owner within one store and gives the same E0106 whichever reason applies.

Find out:
- whether the missing `--project` is the cause, or whether the draft really was gone (for example, used up by the failed submit, or owned by a different session id);
- if it's the project, whether E0106 should name the project the draft is in, or `drafts drop <id>` should find it in any project of the task.

Report the cause and the smallest fix as a note. No code change in this task.
title: Investigate drafts drop not finding a retained draft
